amendments.original: WhatsApp integration cannot be faked in original prototype
amendments.resolution: For the reviewed web demo transport is simulated; future Sakhaa replacement remains explicit.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: One hour equals ten seconds suggests a short full demo
amendments.resolution: Use a separate explicit advance to next unlock action; do not fabricate evidence.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: Supervisor may approve any failed job with a reason
amendments.resolution: Proposed restricted categories; unresolved reused packs missing confirmation and structural stops need dedicated correction.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: Header quantities mention grams while field comments use SKU units
amendments.resolution: Proposed demo decimal SKU quantities with explicit boundary conversions; money integer paise.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: Every point inside and ninety percent inside are ambiguous together
amendments.resolution: Preserve raw location uncertainty and require an explicit reviewed classification policy before gate implementation.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: Quote labour basis is not explicitly distinguished
amendments.resolution: Proposed treated area basis for demo; keep client commercial approval open.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open

amendments.original: Financial warranty may need a later legal stage
amendments.resolution: Demo certificate is marked and illustrative; real backing and terms remain client dependent.
amendments.status: Proposed demo clarification; client policies remain open
